rulesStrings.li: questDescription->You have intercepted a distress signal! A hostile shuttle carrying a Bloodfiend and [escortCount] [escortNoun] is having trouble with its engines. You can use signals to draw it down to a crash near [map_definite].\n\nOnce the ship has crashed, you can fight the Bloodfiend and [bloodfiend_possessive] escort. If you capture the Bloodfiend, one of your colonists can be Embraced by [bloodfiend_objective] and become a Kindred.
shuttleCrashedLetterText->A shuttle carrying a Bloodfiend and [escortCount] [escortNoun] has crashed nearby. They will exit the crashed craft and prepare to fight.
reinforcementsArrivedLetterText->More of the Bloodfiend's [escortNoun] are arriving in drop pods.
assaultBeginLetterText->The Bloodfiend's [escortNoun] have begun an assault on the colony!
